guide.title: Player Guide
guide.subtitle: How to play and game calculations

hero.line1: An elemental dinosaur pet game — hatch eggs, care for pets, level up, battle, and breed.
hero.line2: Everything is powered by your real computer activity.

login.title: Sign up / Log in
login.body: Before logging in you only see an egg on screen with no stats — log in to load your real pet from the cloud.

activity.title: Earn activity from computer use
activity.body: After logging in (on desktop), the app tracks mouse clicks and keyboard input across your machine and converts them into egg progress.

hatch.title: Hatch the egg
hatch.body: Once you've earned enough progress, the egg hatches into 1 of 9 random species with a gender (male/female) and innate element.

care.title: Care for Health / Emotion / Evolution
care.body: Feed, heal, and play with your pet using items and quick-care slots to maintain stats and advance Egg → Baby → Adult.

level.title: Level up
level.body: Level up to pick growth cards and upgrade skills, shaping each pet's playstyle.

pvp.title: Async PvP battles
pvp.body: Create or join a battle room with a code for 1v1 duels, or practice against a bot first.

missions.title: Missions, shopping, breeding
missions.body: Daily and weekly missions earn gems for the market. Keep a breed nest to combine pets and create new eggs.

social.title: Minigames and social features
social.body: Compete in Dino Jump and Rock Dodge rankings, plus friends, chat, and gifts.

species.intro: Taskino has 9 pet species, each tied to one innate element (or two if dual elements are enabled), rolled when the egg hatches.
species.pureDualNote: Pure = one element, Dual = two combined elements (dual elements are temporarily disabled, so all pets hatch as pure for now).

activity.intro: The heart of Taskino is turning real computer use into evolution progress that grows your pet.
activity.formulaNote: In short: 1 click = 1 full point. Typing earns 1 point per 10 key presses — always rounded down. Example: 24 characters typed = only 2 typing points, not 2.4.
activity.healthBody: Your pet's health slowly drops if you don't check in. Restore it with food and medicine items.
activity.emotionBody: Emotion also drops over time. Restore it with toys and playtime.
activity.evolutionBody: Earned directly from activity score (clicks/typing), plus {{vitamin}} (+50 per use).
activity.stagesNote: When evolution reaches the threshold, your pet advances immediately — eggs only have move and hatch animations, while baby and adult unlock the full idle / move / hurt / bite / jump set, and adults render at double size.

care.title: Care & item calculations
care.intro: Every item applies a fixed numeric effect to your pet's stats the moment you use it.
care.quickCareNote: Use quick-care slots (4 slots) without opening the full item bag.

rpgstat.title: RPG stats made simple
rpgstat.intro: Each pet has 4 base stats set by element at hatch. The game converts them into battle-ready values.
rpgstat.summaryNote: Think of the 4 base stats as ingredients. Combat stats (HP/MP/ATK/DEF/EVA) are calculated automatically whenever you enter battle.

growth.title: Levels, Growth Cards & Skills
growth.intro: Evolution takes a pet to adulthood. Levels are the long-term power system afterward — each level-up grants two rewards at once.
growth.cardsIntro: Each level-up, the game offers 3 random cards from this pool — card names hint at the build direction, so the same pet can grow differently each run:
growth.skills1: Each pet has a fixed 4-skill loadout: 3 regular skills + 1 ultimate, rolled by element at hatch.
growth.skills2: Skill upgrade points from level-ups can rank up any skill in the loadout one step at a time.
growth.skills3: Each skill can be upgraded up to Rank 8.
growth.skills4: To change a skill you've invested in, use {{item}} to reset it.

battle.title: Battle & damage basics
battle.intro: Turn-based 1v1 battles — create/join a room with a code, or practice against a bot.
battle.damageFormula: Damage ≈ STR or INT (by skill type) + element advantage + upgraded skill rank
battle.damageNote: The more your attack element beats the opponent's element, the more damage you deal — like typical elemental games (strong vs one, weak vs another).
battle.elementIntro: The game compares the attack's element (normal attacks use the pet's element; skills use the skill's element) against the opponent's innate element(s), then multiplies damage using the values below.
battle.elementNote1: If the opponent has two elements (Dual), advantage applies when strong against either one, and weakness only applies when both defense elements resist the attack element.
battle.elementNote2: Pure (single-element) pets get an extra ×{{bonus}} damage bonus on top of the chart above.
battle.combatNote: During battle, HP / MP / TP (technique points) are calculated only in that room and do not affect your pet's permanent base stats.

breed.intro: Combine two pets to create a new egg.
breed.cooldown: After breeding, you must wait before breeding again.
breed.pureOnly: Offspring currently hatch as pure element only (temporary restriction).

economy.title: Missions & in-game economy
economy.intro: Missions are the main way to earn gems for the market.
economy.missionsBody: Daily and weekly missions sync between your device and the cloud so you can keep playing across devices.
economy.marketBody: Complete missions → earn gems → buy care items, cosmetics, or battle/breeding supplies at the market.

more.rockDodgeBody: Dodge falling rocks and compete for daily item rewards from the scoreboard.

more.social4: View other players' profiles and collections
